name: 60617 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60617 (Chicago) has 292 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 97 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60617 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
